title: VoiceFlow device status (voiceflow-status v1)
description: Written by each device to status/<user>/<device>.json after every refresh that reached the folder. Read by people and assistants to see whether a device is current. Never contains dictated text or words from the lists.

reads.description: What this app version reads, for the readers-before-writers rule (pack/README.md, Versions): a writer of a newer profile version or a new edit type starts only once every device of the user lists it here. Absent: an app from before this field, or a phone: it counts as reading profile version 1 and the edit types correction, term and tombstone only.

pinyin.description: Android 0.9.0 and later: the Chinese engine. Codes and counts only.

active.description: The engine answering keystrokes when the status was written.

lastStart.description: The last Rime start: ok <ms> <data version>, or why it failed.

breaker.description: Rime's crash-loop breaker: tripped after 3 crashes, hangs or failed starts within 24 hours; Classic then serves until Rime is chosen again.

snapshotId.description: Changes when the merged lists change.

pendingEdits.description: Edits made on the device that are not on the share yet.
